svg.title: Fête à Torcy
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG after inspecting a public publisher PDF plate. Approximate contour and interpretive palette. Two blue/yellow rectangular panel sections separated by a dark wooden strip. Overall dimensions from caption; subtle paint texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
